invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object produced by JavaWriteHelper.write, which should never be null if the write operation completes successfully.
getWriteStatuses() should not be null as the metadata is expected to track the outcome of records processed.
The size of a List is always non-negative in Java.
The returned result must be of type HoodieWriteMetadata or its direct subclass due to the method signature.
